name: Crunchy Bridge

evidence.sql: C02: managed SQL database is the primary type; D01: native PostgreSQL
evidence.vector: V01: pgvector available on all Bridge clusters after enablement

line: Run managed PostgreSQL with vector search and SQL scheduling.

free.text: No free tier; bills under $5 are waived; no idle deletion rule; suspend manually

cells.metered: AWS East Standard-4 from $70/month, plus storage
cells.regions: AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud regions

sql.math: $70 for compute, plus 10 GB of allocated storage at $0.10 per GB a month. Tax is not included. The total is $71.
The Standard-4 compute, provisioned for 730 hours, and 10 GB of storage keep billing while idle.

jobs.math: The SQL scheduler runs inside the database. Standalone job-worker resources and prices per run are not published.
